description: Answers a free-form natural-language QUESTION about a single lead/company (e.g. "what does this company sell?", "recent funding?") with web research. Grounds the answer in the company's website when one can be resolved. The answer is AI-generated and may be uncertain; it costs credits. Returns a concise answer plus the source URL used.

columns.description: Optional extra row columns used as research context, same as REST POST /api/research.

prompt.description: The research question to answer about the lead.

name: research_web
title: Pesquisar na web
